cases.title: Stocks in Ports
cases.sum: An analytical dashboard giving a complete, accurate picture of inventory held in ports for better planning and resource management.
sections: Goal
To create an information and analytics tool – a dashboard – that gives a fuller and more accurate picture of inventory in ports, enabling more effective planning and resource management.
Plan
The project began with collecting and consolidating data from every work site: gathering data from multiple sources, processing it and bringing it into a single format.
Result

The consolidated data improved the quality of analytics, sped up business-intelligence processes and delivered insights for strategic planning in logistics and supply-chain management, strengthening the company's competitiveness.
Project blueprint
quote: For the first time we see stock across every port in one place. Weekly planning that used to take two days of spreadsheet work now takes an hour.
Head of supply-chain planning, logistics company

sections: Objective
Automate and visualise data on the movement and use of fuel across the company's energy systems.
Process
Data collection, processing and analysis, then integration with the company's existing resource-management systems – providing full transparency and control at every level.
Result
Automation and visualisation made the company's energy systems more efficient, improved resource management and reduced operational risk.

cases.title: Bank pilot: results for top management
cases.sum: Comprehensive analysis of a bank's pilot project, presented to the bank's top management.
sections: Brief
Carry out a comprehensive analysis of the results of the bank's pilot project and present them to top management.
What it took
Process the month-by-month analytical results since the start of the year.
Consolidate each month's data, grouped by client category and product type.
Identify the most effective client-acquisition channels within the pilot.
Visualise the data and surface the key insights.
Build the storyline and design the presentation.
quote: The team turned months of pilot data into a story the board understood in one meeting. The decision to scale was made on the strength of those slides.

cases.title: Project 5-100: final results
cases.sum: Final results presentation for Project 5-100, the national programme to raise the global competitiveness of Russian universities.
sections: Brief
A final presentation of the results of Project 5-100.
Context

Project 5-100 was an important step in the development of Russian higher education, even though its ultimate goals were not reached. It raised universities' awareness of international standards and of the need to improve the quality of teaching and research.
quote: hice. took a decade of programme data and made the results clear to both officials and university leaders, without losing any of the nuance.
